warning: Planning arithmetic, not a measured throughput forecast. Each unit must visit every stage once; observations must time one full unit and one stage. Parallel servers are assumed identical, continuously available and independent. No variability, queueing, setup, rework, breaks, shared workers or material constraints are modeled.
